pages.title: Stylish Nail Art
pages.creator: iclickgames
pages.description: Stylish Nail Art lets you create a manicure by combining nail polish, patterns, stickers, and accessories. Use the mouse to explore different colors and decorations, then build a theme for your nail designs. Try coordinating the details across the nails or giving each one a different treatment. After decorating, choose a background to present the finished manicure.

pages.title: X to Y: Almost Impossible!
pages.creator: GamesMrkt
pages.description:
X to Y: Almost Impossible! is a precision movement game about guiding X through narrow spaces and hazards to reach Y. Manage your speed carefully as you pass traps and line up each move. A mistake ends the attempt, while successful levels can earn up to three stars toward unlocking new worlds. Later challenges include dark settings, automatic movement, and physics puzzles.

Move with WASD or the arrow keys, combining them with Shift for faster movement or Space to slow down. You can also drag with the left mouse button, or hold and drag on a touch screen.

pages.title: Dinosaur Rampage
pages.creator: Raccoon
pages.description: Dinosaur Rampage puts you in an arena where destruction determines your place in the rankings. Move your dinosaur around the arena and let its automatic attacks do the smashing as you try to outperform the other dinosaurs. When the rampage finishes, compare your destruction performance with the competition. Different dinosaur types can be unlocked, and the shop offers skins for changing your creature's appearance. On a computer, click to move; touch controls use a virtual joystick or a dragging gesture.

pages.title: Color Water Puzzle
pages.creator: Big Wave
pages.description:
Color Water Puzzle asks you to separate mixed water into glasses containing a single color. Select a glass, then choose where to pour its top layer. Check the top color and available space in the receiving glass before transferring water, since the order of your pours matters.

Keep useful space available while moving colors into their own glasses. If an arrangement becomes stuck, you can restart the level. The game also provides an extra-glass prop that can create more room for sorting.

pages.title: On Fire Basketball Shots
pages.creator: SecGame
pages.description: On Fire Basketball Shots is a physics shooting game about launching a ball from one basket to the next. Drag to adjust the direction and strength of a shot, then release to send the ball toward the next hoop. Use the displayed trajectory to judge where the launch will take it. Each new basket sets up another shot, so keep adjusting your aim to carry the ball through the sequence of hoops.

pages.title: Durak
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Durak is a card game for two to four players in which you try to avoid being the last player holding cards. Each match uses a deck of 36 cards, with ranks running from six through ace in all four suits. Work toward getting the cards out of your hand while watching how the match develops.

pages.title: Fusion 2048
pages.creator: Tejas Shrimali
pages.description: Fusion 2048 combines matching numbered blocks into higher values, with 2048 as the target to work toward. Drag a block into position and release it to drop it into the container, choosing placements that bring matching numbers together. Keep an eye on the available space so the container does not fill up before you make another combination. Classic and Shape modes offer different ways to play, while TNT blocks can clear room when the arrangement becomes crowded.

pages.title: Foam and Find
pages.creator: GameDev.Land
pages.description: Foam and Find is a hidden object game in which floating bubbles show the items you need to locate. Choose a house, enter a room, and compare the scene with the objects displayed in the bubbles. Click or tap a matching object to send it into its bubble and pop it. Finish the room's tasks to continue exploring and unlock more houses. There is no timer, so you can inspect each scene at your own pace.

pages.title: Brainrot Memory
pages.creator: AF
pages.description: Brainrot Memory turns characters from Italian Brainrot memes into a card matching puzzle. Flip cards to uncover their pictures, then find the card with the same character to make a pair. Remember the positions of pictures you have already revealed as you work through the remaining cards. The game offers two difficulty settings and a collection of meme characters to discover.

pages.title: Idle Game Prison Life
pages.creator: Online Games
pages.description: Idle Game Prison Life is a prison management simulator about building and expanding a secure facility. Plan a layout with cells, kitchens, gyms, and surveillance, then recruit staff such as guards and medics to support its operation. Use upgrades to develop the prison as you take on more management tasks. The focus is on organizing the facility and its workforce as it grows. Click or tap to interact with the management controls.

pages.title: Stickman battle 1-4 Players
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description:
Stickman battle 1-4 Players collects several competitive action games in one place. Fight using rotating weapons, take part in football, race for first place, or tackle survival challenges. Play with friends and bots in sessions for up to four players, choosing a quick round or a tournament that runs across several rounds.

Each mode displays its own controls before play begins. Crystals found during play can buy cars, faces, and colors, while completed rounds award keys after the winner is announced. Use those keys to open additional modes.

pages.title: Color Block Jam
pages.creator: DRA
pages.description: Color Block Jam is a sliding puzzle about moving colored shapes through matching gates. Drag the blocks around the board and open a clear route to an exit of the same color. A shape must fit through its gate, and other blocks can get in the way of its path. Work out which pieces to move first and clear the required shapes to complete the level.

pages.title: Mega Ramp Car
pages.creator: DarkPlay
pages.description: Mega Ramp Car is a driving and stunt game built around large ramps and long jumps. Choose a car and take on levels and missions that send you over different jumps, with opportunities to drift and perform tricks along the way. The game includes several modes and a collection of vehicles to buy. Work through its driving challenges and try different cars as you take on the next set of ramps.

pages.title: Boxteria
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description:
Boxteria is a sandbox action game set in a blocky world with vehicles, character creation, battles, and races. Explore maps including Russian Village and Courtyard, choose from 20 cars, and assemble groups of bandits, zombies, or police characters.

On a computer, Tab selects a character or vehicle to spawn, while the left mouse button fires or places the selected item. Scroll the mouse wheel to change weapons or tools, press Space to jump, B to enter a car, and V to start a war. Phone controls appear on screen.

pages.title: Wild Race Master 3d
pages.creator: CarGames.Com
pages.description: Wild Race Master 3d is a driving game that sends you through winding tracks with different road layouts. Choose from a range of cars and guide your vehicle through the turns and changing track conditions. Use the mouse or touch controls to manage your car as you take on each course. Keep watching the road ahead so you can adjust your driving to the next bend.

pages.title: Sorting frogs
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Sorting frogs asks you to gather four identical frogs on the same log. Click or tap a log to select its frogs, then choose another log where you want them to move. When a move is allowed, the selected frog jumps across. A group of four matching frogs leaves the log and earns a reward. Work through different level arrangements, earn achievements, and unlock more frog types as you progress.

pages.title: Little master of assembly
pages.creator: Shenzhen haikuo yuntour rede tecnologia co., LTD
pages.description: Little master of assembly is a furniture assembly puzzle set in illustrated rooms. Look at the reference room and choose an object to work on, then fit its parts together to recreate the pictured furnishing. Click the furniture to begin its assembly task and use the reference to understand how the pieces belong together. Complete the objects that make up the room.

pages.title: Space Shooter - Speed Typing Challenge
pages.creator: Bad Games AB
pages.description: Space Shooter - Speed Typing Challenge turns typing into your spaceship's weapon. Enemy ships arrive with words beside them, and entering those words correctly fires at the targets. Watch the incoming enemies, read their words, and type accurately as the waves continue. The challenge combines recognizing the next target with keeping your keyboard input quick and precise.

pages.title: Math Quest
pages.creator: TuuT
pages.description: Math Quest is a timed arithmetic game about working out answers before the allotted time ends. Read each problem, calculate the result, and choose the correct response to continue through the challenges. Progress takes you into new levels of questions. Keep your attention on both the calculation and the remaining time as you work through each set.

pages.title: Panda Running
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Panda Running is an endless runner set along a bamboo forest trail. Guide the panda past traps, tree stumps, and boulders, jumping over obstacles as the run continues. Collect power-ups along the route for protection and boosts. Watch the ground ahead and time each jump so the panda can keep moving through the forest for a longer run.

pages.title: Coin Smash
pages.creator: AzureStorm Entertainment
pages.description: Coin Smash sends you through mazes to collect coins while enemies try to stop you. Follow the passages, find the remaining coins, and change your route when a foe gets in the way. Your task is to gather the coins in time while staying clear of the pursuers. Move with WASD, the arrow keys, or a mouse drag on a computer; touch play uses dragging.

pages.title: BFFs E Girl Vs Soft Girl
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description: BFFs E Girl Vs Soft Girl is a dress-up game in which Ellie and her friends try two different fashion looks. Explore the sweet, pink focused Soft Girl style, then put together an E-girl outfit for comparison. Choose clothing combinations for the friends and see how the two aesthetics change their appearance. Use the left mouse button to make your selections.

pages.title: K Games Challenge
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: K Games Challenge brings together six contest types inspired by Squid Game, with computer controlled opponents. The events include Honeycomb Toffee and Marbles, alongside Tug of War, Stepping Stones, Red Light, Green Light, and SP Game. Each challenge changes the action you need to perform, with limited time to complete its task. In Marbles, for example, you have six attempts to get a marble into the hole. Tap and slide to control your actions and follow the rules presented for the current event.

pages.title: Real Football
pages.creator: Gameloft SE
pages.description: Real Football combines football matches with managing a team toward championship success. Build your squad and lead it through league or cup competition, working toward becoming world champions. The game brings team management and football simulation together, letting you shape the side that takes the field. Follow the instructions shown during play to learn the available actions as you guide your team through its matches.

pages.title: My New Years Sparkling Outfits
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description: My New Years Sparkling Outfits lets you style a group of friends for a New Year surprise party. Choose a sparkling outfit for each girl, then add accessories that work with the clothes. Complete the party look with a hairstyle, trying different combinations across the group. Use the left mouse button to select the fashion items and prepare the friends for their celebration.

pages.title: Ball Sort Soccer
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: Ball Sort Soccer is a color sorting puzzle played with soccer balls in tubes. Tap a tube to select its top ball, then tap a destination to move it. A ball placed on another ball must match its color, so consider the exposed colors before making a transfer. Work toward separating the mixed balls into tubes of matching colors, using the available room to organize the stacks.

pages.title: Ocean Bubble Shooter
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: Ocean Bubble Shooter asks you to clear colored bubbles by joining groups of at least three matching colors. Aim the bubble you have been given at the cluster in the play area, choosing a landing position that creates a match. Try to remove the bubbles with fewer shots as you continue through its unlimited levels. Move the pointer and click to shoot on a computer, or drag to aim and release to fire on a touch screen.

pages.title: FPS Assault Shooter
pages.creator: Royale Gamers
pages.description: FPS Assault Shooter is a first person combat game about choosing a weapon and fighting enemy forces across different scenarios. Build your progress through its ranking and level system, then improve your weapons with upgrades. Move around the battlefield with WASD or the arrow keys, use the mouse to line up a target, and fire with the left mouse button. The right mouse button aims, while G throws a grenade. Choose your approach to each encounter and keep developing your equipment as you advance.

pages.title: Boom Town
pages.creator: Podge Games
pages.description:
Boom Town mixes explosive gold mining with building a settlement. Choose a plot, buy explosives, and place your charges to free the gold beneath the ground. Drive your truck to collect the ore, then use the proceeds to improve your equipment and develop the town. Upgrades cover your rig, refinery, and explosive power.

Use the mouse for purchasing, placing charges, detonating them, and construction. The truck can be driven with the arrow keys, WASD, or the mouse. There is no time limit, so you can plan each mining operation at your own pace.

pages.title: The Dawn Of Slenderman
pages.creator: danygames.com
pages.description: The Dawn Of Slenderman is a 3D horror game about searching for eight pages while something follows you through a forest. Explore the surroundings and keep looking for the remaining pages as you try to complete the search. The game includes day and night settings. Use WASD to move and the mouse to look around; Shift runs, Ctrl crouches, and Space jumps.

pages.title: Dr Dice
pages.creator: Zigiz
pages.description:
Dr Dice is a dice combination game set in a chaotic professor's laboratory. You can roll up to three times on each turn before recording a combination on the chart. Available combinations are highlighted after the third roll, and the game ends once every entry has been crossed off.

Use the combo system to reroll one die, reroll all dice, or set a die to a particular value. These choices can help you finish combinations on the chart. Any liquid remaining in the combo meter at the end adds bonus points.

pages.title: Pixelcraft Differences
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Pixelcraft Differences challenges you to find small changes in scenes featuring Minecraft characters. Inspect the pictures closely, then click or tap a difference to mark it with a red circle. Those marks help you keep track of details you have already found. Work through ten levels without hints, watching the time as you search. Random clicking brings a warning, and running out of time means starting the attempt again.

pages.title: BFF Gipsy Trends
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: BFF Gipsy Trends is a fashion game featuring Mia, Emma, Clara, and Sophie. Help the four friends choose outfits and accessories from the themed wardrobe, comparing combinations to create a look for each princess. Use the mouse to select the items you want them to wear. Try different pairings across the group and see how each friend's finished outfit comes together.

pages.title: QUANTITIES
pages.creator: nau.games
pages.description: QUANTITIES is a counting game that connects pictured amounts with numbers. Look at the quantity shown, count it, and click the matching number from the available answers. A correct answer takes you to the next question, while a wrong choice gives feedback so you can try again. Work through the different quantities and keep checking your count before choosing.

pages.title: My Dog
pages.creator: nau.games
pages.description: My Dog is a pet care game with activities for feeding, bathing, playing, and looking after an unwell dog. Click the activity buttons to choose what you want to do and watch the dog's response in the selected scene. Switch between the care activities to explore different parts of looking after the virtual pet.

pages.title: Monster of Eye
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Monster of Eye is a timing puzzle about placing spikes into a large rotating monster. Tap when a clear section turns into position, sending another spike toward the target. Avoid the small monsters riding around it and the spikes that are already attached. Each successful placement leaves less open space for the next shot, so watch the rotation before choosing when to tap.

pages.title: Desert City Stunt
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description:
Desert City Stunt sends you through six timed driving levels in a desert city. Cross the obstacles with armored vehicles and finish each stage before the timer runs out to unlock another car. You can also choose Free Driving to explore and perform stunts without the countdown.

The game provides controls for two players: player one drives with the arrow keys, uses N for nitro, and B to look back. Player two uses WASD to drive, T for nitro, and C to look back. Press R to respawn.

pages.title: Space Memory
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Space Memory is a card puzzle about finding matching space pictures. Use the mouse or touchpad to reveal cards, then select another with the same icon to make a pair. Keep track of where the pictures appear as you work through the board. Match every card to finish the level and continue to the next arrangement of space themed tiles.

pages.title: The Linear Basketball
pages.creator: Best Kids Games
pages.description: The Linear Basketball uses drawn lines to guide basketballs into hoops. Draw a route with the mouse or touch controls so a ball reaches a basket and earns points. Be careful with bombs: they must stay out of the hoops. As the game continues, more balls and baskets appear and the pace increases, giving you more paths to manage at once.

pages.title: US Bus Transport Service 2020
pages.creator: chipchop
pages.description: US Bus Transport Service 2020 is a city bus driving game about providing passenger pick-up and drop-off services. Take the role of a coach driver and carry visitors around the city through multiple transport levels. The game also offers parking tasks, challenge modes, and free roaming. Choose a driving activity and work on getting the bus to the destination required by that task.

pages.title: LOL Jigsaw Puzzle
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: LOL Jigsaw Puzzle lets you assemble pictures of L.O.L. characters from separate puzzle pieces. Choose a character design and work out where its pieces belong to rebuild the complete image. Compare the details across the pieces as the picture takes shape. Use the mouse or touch controls to play through the different character illustrations in the set.

pages.title: City Transport Memory
pages.creator: STA network
pages.description: City Transport Memory is a four-level tile matching game. Reveal the hidden pictures with a click or tap, then find two identical tiles to make a pair. Remember where each picture appears when the tiles do not match, so you can return to it later. Clear every pair to win the level and try to finish with as few moves as you can.

pages.title: Galactic Attack
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Galactic Attack is a 2D space shooter with eight levels and two bosses to overcome. Guide your hero through the battles, firing at enemies as you work toward saving the galaxy. Use the arrow keys to move, Space to shoot, and X to change weapons. Learn when to reposition and when to keep firing as you take on the stages and their boss encounters.

pages.title: Heli Defence
pages.creator: FTG
pages.description: Heli Defence puts you in control of a helicopter defending against enemy attacks. Move the helicopter with the mouse, keep firing at the opposition, and use rockets when you need additional firepower. Avoid incoming bullets and make use of shields to help protect the aircraft. Stay aware of both your targets and the projectiles approaching as the fight continues.

pages.title: Spot The Difference
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: Spot The Difference asks you to find the odd item among a group of similar looking objects. Inspect the group, identify what makes one object different, and click or tap it before the timer expires. Each challenge tests how quickly you can notice the changed detail. Keep comparing the objects carefully as you move through more sets.

pages.title: Sliding Figure
pages.creator: JZJO.COM
pages.description: Sliding Figure is a car control game about weaving through scenery while avoiding obstacles. Press the left mouse button to turn left, then release it to turn right. Alternate between the two directions to keep the car on a clear route and away from objects in its path. Collect coins along the way and try to keep driving long enough to raise your score.

pages.title: Baby Hazel NewYear Bash
pages.creator: Baby Hazel
pages.description: Baby Hazel NewYear Bash follows Hazel and her family on a trip to an Ice Castle celebration. Join Hazel and her dad aboard the cruise liner and help them reach Uncle John's New Year party. Use the mouse to interact with the characters and respond to Hazel's requests during the journey. Keep her happy along the way, then join the snowy festivities at the castle.

pages.title: Cartoon Motorcycles Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Cartoon Motorcycles Puzzle is a jigsaw collection featuring six illustrated motorcycle pictures. Choose an image, then select a puzzle size of 16, 36, 64, or 100 pieces. Use the mouse to place the pieces and rebuild the full picture, matching the motorcycle details as the image comes together. Try the same illustration with more pieces for a more involved puzzle.

pages.title: Besties Outing Day
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Besties Outing Day is a dress-up game about preparing Mia, Bella, and Ana for a day together. Use the mouse to choose outfits for the three friends and put together their looks before they head out. Once they are dressed, select the place for their outing. Try different clothing combinations to give each friend her own style for the day.

pages.title: Flappy FootChinko
pages.creator: RavalMatic
pages.description: Flappy FootChinko combines soccer goals with tap controlled ball movement. Click or tap to make the ball jump, timing each impulse to dodge obstacles and reach the goal. Story mode lets you work through seven international tournaments, while endless mode focuses on keeping your timing consistent for a longer run. Watch the space ahead of the ball and choose each tap to guide it through the next opening.

pages.title: Slide The Box
pages.creator: Hasanuddin University
pages.description: Slide The Box is a quick reaction game about removing boxes from a stack. Look at the arrow on the next box and click the left or right button that matches its direction. Keep clearing boxes to build your score while the timer counts down. The task is to recognize each arrow quickly and choose the correct button before time runs out.

pages.title: Christmas Match 3 Deluxe
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Christmas Match 3 Deluxe asks you to make groups of at least three identical holiday items and meet the target for each level. Use the mouse to make your matches, keeping the current objective in mind as you work through the board. Hourglasses, bombs, and jolly items provide help along the way. Later levels make the targets harder to achieve, so consider which matches will bring you closer to finishing.

pages.title: Snowball Fight
pages.creator: Functu
pages.description: Snowball Fight is a winter shooting game against Grinch characters. Use the mouse to click a Grinch and throw a snowball at that target. Keep looking for the next enemy as you choose where to aim. The simple click controls keep the action focused on spotting a target and landing your next snowball.

pages.title: FreeCell
pages.creator: Instant Games Studio
pages.description:
FreeCell deals every card face up and challenges you to move them into four foundations, one for each suit, running from ace to king. On the main board, build descending sequences with alternating red and black cards. Use a free cell to hold a card temporarily when it helps expose another move.

Keep some free cells open: the number available affects how many cards you can move together. The scoring system deducts points for moving cards, so plan your sequence of moves and aim to complete the foundations efficiently. Use the mouse to rearrange the cards.

pages.title: Monster Boxes
pages.creator: jogosonlineapps.com.br
pages.description: Monster Boxes is a cannon puzzle about bringing monsters of different colors together. Adjust the cannon's power and shoot a monster into a box occupied by a differently colored monster. Avoid sending it into a box with a monster of the same color. Study the distance to the destination before choosing your shot strength, and try to complete the pairings with as few shots as possible.

pages.title: Christmas Balls
pages.creator: Instant Games Studio
pages.description: Christmas Balls is a matching game about connecting holiday baubles of the same color. Use the mouse to join matching balls and look for longer connections to increase your score. Inspect the arrangement for colors that can form a larger group before making your next connection. Keep building matches as you work toward a better result.

pages.title: Sky Jet Wars
pages.creator: BestCrazyGames.com
pages.description: Sky Jet Wars is a ship combat game about moving into position and firing on enemy targets. Use WASD to control your ship, then click the on-screen fire and rocket buttons to attack. Keep adjusting your movement as you line up another target. Choose when to use the regular weapon or rockets as you fight the opposing ships.

pages.title: Speedy Musle Cars Jigsaw
pages.creator: STA network
pages.description: Speedy Musle Cars Jigsaw offers 12 car pictures to reconstruct as jigsaw puzzles. Select an image, then choose easy with 25 pieces, medium with 49, or hard with 100. Use the mouse or touch controls to put the pieces in place and rebuild the complete picture. Pick a smaller puzzle for fewer pieces to sort, or take on a larger arrangement with more details to match.

pages.title: Christmas Connection
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Christmas Connection is a holiday match three puzzle about rescuing Christmas items transformed into balls by a wizard's spell. Line up at least three identical items to make a match, then look for the next group to clear. Your aim is to score as much as possible within a short time. Use the mouse or touch controls and keep searching the board for useful matches.

pages.title: Racing Rocket
pages.creator: CD GAMES
pages.description: Racing Rocket is a car racing game with missions to complete, vehicle choices, and upgrades. Use the right arrow to accelerate and the left arrow to brake. Manage your pace as you drive the course and work toward its finish. Completion rewards can help you develop your vehicles and prepare for more of the game's driving challenges.

pages.title: Hero Runner
pages.creator: ClearCut Games ApS
pages.description: Hero Runner is an arcade running game about getting past obstacles and keeping your run going. Click, tap, or press Space to jump as your character advances. A second tap performs a double jump, giving you another way to clear a difficult obstacle. Watch what is approaching and choose the timing of each jump as you try to extend the attempt and improve your score.

pages.title: Monster Truck Way
pages.creator: Bnagames
pages.description: Monster Truck Way is a side view driving game about reaching each finish line quickly while collecting gold coins. Guide the truck across platform style courses, balancing progress through the terrain with collecting the coins along your route. The game has eight levels across two locations. Use the arrow keys and Space, or the touch controls, to take on the driving stages.

pages.title: Baby Hazel Craft Time
pages.creator: Baby Hazel
pages.description: Baby Hazel Craft Time follows Hazel as she prepares a school craft assignment. Begin by helping her find and buy the supplies she needs at the stationery shop. Then help her complete the project so she can present it to her teacher. Use the mouse to interact with the items and respond to Hazel's needs as you work through shopping, making the craft, and handing it in.

pages.title: Zombie Gems
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Zombie Gems is a match three puzzle that uses zombie faces as its matching pieces. Make groups of matching zombies, look for combinations, and use power-ups to clear more of the board. There are seven zombie types and 20 different power-ups in the game. Plan matches that can lead into further combinations as you try to raise your score across the spooky board.

pages.title: Car Racing 3D
pages.creator: Instant Games Studio
pages.description: Car Racing 3D combines driving with a coin collection goal. Use the arrow keys to move the car and gather the coins required for the current stage. Reaching that target opens the next level, giving you another collection task to complete. Keep track of the coins you still need as you steer through each driving challenge.

pages.title: Fun Race 3D
pages.creator: BestGames
pages.description: Fun Race 3D is an obstacle course sprint in which you try to finish ahead of the other runners. Use the mouse to control your run and work through the obstacles placed along the track. Watch the course as you advance, choosing your moments to move past each obstruction. Get through the runway and overtake your rivals to take first place.

pages.title: Dog Racing Simulator
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Dog Racing Simulator sends your chosen dog down race tracks with hurdles to jump and lanes to switch between. Use A and D or the left and right arrows to change lanes, W or Space to jump, and Left Shift for a boost. Time your movement around the obstacles while competing for a stronger race position. The game includes multiple levels and different dog models to choose from.

pages.title: Kung Fu Brick Breaker
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Kung Fu Brick Breaker is a timing game about striking bricks when a filling gauge reaches its target zone. Click at the right moment to land a Good or Perfect hit and move on to another break. Consecutive Perfect hits build a combo for additional points. As you progress, the gauge fills faster and the target zone shrinks. A missed strike ends the run, so keep watching the gauge before committing to the next hit.

pages.title: Battle Royale Puzzle Challenge
pages.creator: yaine
pages.description: Battle Royale Puzzle Challenge is a jigsaw game featuring pictures inspired by Fortnite Battle Royale. Choose a picture and a difficulty setting, then fit its pieces together to restore the full scene. The game offers easy, medium, and hard puzzle choices. There is no time limit, so you can compare the pieces and rebuild each image at your own pace.

pages.title: House Paint
pages.creator: BestGames
pages.description: House Paint is a painting puzzle about covering the white walls of a house with color. Use the arrow keys to move the painter across each surface, filling the blank areas as it travels. Look for unpainted sections around windows and other features, and plan a route that reaches them. Finish a wall to continue around the house and keep painting until its surfaces are complete.

pages.title: Hit Targets Shooting
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Hit Targets Shooting is a first person shooting game about lining up shots at objects in a 3D environment. Move with WASD and use the mouse to aim and shoot at breakable targets such as bottles and vases. Work through the shooting challenges from different positions, judging your aim before firing. Keep your attention on the target objects as you complete each stage.

pages.title: Princess Food Court
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Princess Food Court is a restaurant game about serving food within a time limit. Use the mouse to handle the serving tasks and complete the required work before the countdown ends. Keep track of the food service as you work through the current challenge.

pages.title: Boats Coloring Book
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Boats Coloring Book lets you choose a boat picture and give it your own colors. Pick an image, select a shade with the brush, and apply it to the illustration. Try different combinations across the boat as you work on the picture. The activity focuses on coloring the selected drawing and choosing how you want the finished scene to look.

pages.title: Space Rider
pages.creator: Fr Games
pages.description: Space Rider challenges you to travel through yellow scoring circles as you cross a space course. Line up each approach to pass through a ring, collect its points, and continue toward the next one. Keep following the circle route and try to collect all its points.

pages.title: Goldie Emo Makeup
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Goldie Emo Makeup lets you create an emo inspired makeover for Goldie. Begin with her skin care preparation, then choose face contouring shapes, eyelashes, and colorful eye makeup. Combine those cosmetics with face painting designs to complete the style. Tap to select the available options and experiment with different pairings across her eyes and face.

pages.title: Sweety Memory
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Sweety Memory is a timed card matching puzzle with four levels. Find identical cards and remember their positions so you can complete more pairs before the clock runs out. The stages progress from an easier opening board to a harder final challenge. Matching cards quickly helps you score more points, so use the pictures you have already seen to make your next selection.

pages.title: Mob City
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Mob City is an action game about tackling missions in a city troubled by rising crime. Drive cars and use powerful weapons to carry out the assignments. Follow the current mission objective as you work through the city's challenges, bringing together vehicle use and armed action.

pages.title: Super Speed Runner
pages.creator: T
pages.description: Super Speed Runner is an automatic runner about jumping between platforms without falling. Click or touch to make the character jump as it moves forward, timing each takeoff to reach the next landing. Crossing platforms builds your score, while the run becomes faster and the gaps between platforms grow. Watch the next platform's height and distance before jumping, and try to stay on the course for a longer run.

pages.title: Mango Piggy Piggy Hero
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Mango Piggy Piggy Hero is a launch puzzle about superhero pigs defending their town from invading robots. Send a hero pig toward the enemy, choosing a launch that reaches the robot targets. Different challenges call for combinations of pig heroes, and boss encounters add larger threats to overcome. The game offers more than 30 levels per episode, with new arrangements to work through as you continue the defense.

pages.title: Ellie Ressurection Emergency
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Ellie Ressurection Emergency is a hospital simulation in which you play a doctor helping Ellie during an emergency. Tap through the on-screen treatment tasks and simulated CPR sequence as you work to help your patient recover.

pages.title: Word Chef Cookies
pages.creator: BestGames
pages.description: Word Chef Cookies turns letter covered cookies into a word finding puzzle. Draw a line through the cookies to connect letters in the order that forms a word. Try different letter sequences to uncover all the hidden words in the current puzzle. Look at the available letters again after each discovery and keep connecting them until you have found the remaining words.

pages.title: Summer Fun
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Summer Fun is a dress-up game about getting three princesses ready for a day at the water park. Choose pool outfits for the group and put together a summer look for each character. Compare the available clothing combinations as you prepare the princesses for their outing. The focus is on styling the three friends for their day by the pool.

pages.title: Princess Odd Jobs Choice
pages.creator: Games Banner Network
pages.description: Princess Odd Jobs Choice follows Aurora as she explores unusual professions during her winter holiday. Help her try the roles of island keeper, pet psychologist, waterslide tester, and color expert. Choose an outfit suited to each job so she is dressed for its setting. Work through the different professional looks and see how the clothes change with the activity she wants to try.

pages.title: Dotted Girl Family Christmas
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Dotted Girl Family Christmas combines tidying a room with preparing it for Santa's visit. Help Dotted Girl clean the windows, put clothes in the basket, and remove the dust. Once the room is ready, choose decorations and gingerbread to leave for Santa. Tap through the household activities, then enjoy the family's Christmas celebration as the children wait for their presents.

pages.title: Street Ball Jam
pages.creator: Miniduck
pages.description: Street Ball Jam is a basketball arcade game built around one touch controls. Time your shots to make baskets and build combinations that can earn a fireball. Try different characters as you play, and unlock additional courts and balls. Keep working on the timing of each attempt as you aim to improve your basketball score.

pages.title: 100 Trendy Crop Top Looks for Princess
pages.creator: Games Banner Network
pages.description: 100 Trendy Crop Top Looks for Princess is a fashion game about putting together outfits around crop tops. Browse the wardrobe, pair a top with a matching bottom, and adjust the other parts of the princess's look. Try different hair, footwear, and accessory choices to complete the outfit. Compare combinations until the clothing and finishing details work together in the style you want.

pages.title: Game of the Goose
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Game of the Goose is a board game in which you race your pawn to the final square ahead of the other players. Click the dice button to roll and move along the board, dealing with the traps and special spaces you encounter. Each roll changes your position in the race. Keep progressing toward the last square and try to reach it before your opponents.

pages.title: Princess or Minion
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Princess or Minion is a dress-up game about giving Anna, Snow White, Rapunzel, and Ariel outfits inspired by the Minions. Explore clothes in yellow and blue, combining dresses, tops, skirts, and shoes for different occasions. The friends want Minion themed looks for activities such as a night out or a beach day. Finish their outfits with accessories like oversized goggles or a hat, then compare the styles you have created for the group.

pages.title: Princesses Paris Shopping Spree
pages.creator: Games Banner Network
pages.description: Princesses Paris Shopping Spree joins Elsa and Rapunzel on a fashion trip to Paris. Help them shop for dresses, shoes, and accessories at the Gallery Lafayette mall. Explore the available pieces and choose combinations for each princess as they update their wardrobes. Put the clothing and accessories together to create new looks for the two friends during their shopping visit.

pages.title: Silly Ways to Die: Differences 2
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Silly Ways to Die: Differences 2 is a picture comparison game about finding the details that do not match. Inspect the scenes closely and use the mouse to select the differences you notice. Find the required changes to complete the current level, then continue to another picture challenge.

pages.title: Mahjong Connect 2
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Mahjong Connect 2 challenges you to clear the board by linking identical mahjong tiles. A pair needs an open connecting path with no more than two turns, so matching pictures alone are not enough. Select tiles with the mouse or touch controls and look for connections that open space for further pairs. Work against the timer, using the hint and shuffle tools when you need help finding another move.

pages.title: Sugar Mahjong
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Sugar Mahjong is a tile connecting puzzle featuring candy designs across 100 levels. Find matching candy tiles and connect the pairs to remove them from the arrangement. Keep examining the remaining pieces as each removal changes the board. Use the mouse or touch controls to choose your matches and work toward clearing all the candy tiles in the current level.

pages.title: Latina Princess Spa Day
pages.creator: Play Belle Games
pages.description: Latina Princess Spa Day is a salon game about giving Elena of Avalor a facial care session. Help the princess with the game's skin care activities, using the salon tools and face masks to complete her spa treatment. Work through the virtual makeover as she prepares to feel ready for royal events. The focus is on caring for the character and completing her salon visit.

pages.title: Rachel Meetings on a Rush
pages.creator: Racz Ioan Paul II
pages.description: Rachel Meetings on a Rush is a dress-up game about choosing three outfits for a busy day. Help Rachel prepare a look for the office, another for lunch, and a third for a party with her friends. Select clothes that fit each appointment and add accessories that match the outfit. Move through the three occasions and give her a different style for each part of her schedule.
